page.overview:
Who is Allen Heath?

Allen Fred Heath (January 3, 1918 - March 6, 1981) was a Canadian driver who entered two Formula One races, the 1952 and 1953 Indianapolis 500, but failed to qualify for either of those races. He was the first Canadian to attempt to qualify for a Formula 1 race.
